draft.emotion: warm, sincere, and physically close, conveying comfort or genuine affection
notes: Unlike อุ้ม (ûm), which means to lift and hold someone or something in your arms (such as carrying a baby or pet), กอด simply means to wrap your arms around them.
Also appears in the common expression กอดอก (kɔ̀ɔt òk, 'to fold/cross one's arms across the chest').
